text:
sam: Heads-up — I hit a lint failure in the route authoring preflight that looks bogus when using anchored header matchers + header overrides.

anya: Can you paste the snippet + the linter error?

sam: Sure. repro is tiny:
```yaml
routes:
  - id: auth-proxy
    match:
      path: /auth/*
      headers:
        Authorization: 
          regex: '^Bearer\\s.+$'  # anchored regex
    override_headers:
      X-Forwarded-User: $user_id
```
Linter says: "header matcher uses unsupported token '$'" which is wrong, it's just my regex.

jared: Ugh, I ran into this when we changed the tokenizer for the linter. It treats `$` as our interpolation marker if the header matcher is parsed as a literal string instead of a regex.

priya: Is this only when `override_headers` is present? Or any time a header matcher contains anchors? :thinking:

sam: Only reproducible when both are present in the same route object — console preview also drops the whole header matcher in the UI preview, so the route looks more permissive which scares me.

jared: Hypothesis: the schema->tokens step flattens header matcher values without tagging them as `regex`. If we see a leading `^` or trailing `$` probably we should treat the value as a regex and skip interpolation scanning.

devex-bot: FYI — there is a preflight lint rule `no-unescaped-interpolation` that flags `$` inside strings. That rule runs before the regex-special-case we added last quarter.

anya: Two potential fixes: (A) make the linter detect common regex anchors and skip the interpolation check, or (B) add an explicit `type: regex` discriminator in the header matcher schema so UI and linter know the intent.

priya: Option B is cleaner long-term but needs a tiny Console UX change (dropdown or inferred behaviour) and a migration note. Option A is faster and low-risk.

sam: For short term, I'd prefer A (fast fix). But we should avoid heuristic regressions — need tests.

jared: I'll open a PR that: 1) updates the tokenizer to ignore `$`/`^` when value matches `^\^.*\$?$` pattern, 2) adds unit tests under `eng-platform/tests/routing/lint/` with these two YAML cases, 3) adds an e2e route preview test that asserts header matcher shows up in Console preview.

anya: Thanks. For the Console side, I'll add a UI hint to the preflight modal: "Using regex anchors? Consider marking this header matcher as regex to avoid false positives" — we can wire that to the migration later.

priya: Small callout: if we treat anchored regex as regex, we also need to ensure our traffic-splitting and prefix caching logic still respects regex-backed header matches (edge-case seen before where prefix cache key ignored header regex). Add a telemetry tag to the preview when this config is used so we can monitor traffic after fix. :eyes:

devex-bot: Action items recorded: jared -> linter PR + tests; anya -> Console hint + preview test; priya -> telemetry event; sam -> attach failing YAML to PR.

sam: I'll attach the failing snippet and a screen recording of the Console preview. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
